تهاتفت (form VI)

# تَهَاتَفْتَ (tahātafta) /ta.haː.taf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
# تَهَاتَفْتِ (tahātafti) /ta.haː.taf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
# تَهَاتَفَتْ (tahātafat) /ta.haː.ta.fat/: third-person fem
